title: Atlas Ownership
text: Atlas is operated by the Platform Reliability team.

title: Platform Reliability Production Storage
text: Platform Reliability maintains Borealis for production customer-profile storage.

title: Borealis Production Backup Policy
text: Production Borealis incremental backups run every six hours.

title: Borealis Production Backup Policy — Previous Revision
text: Production Borealis incremental backups run every twelve hours. This was the previous production backup policy before the current six-hour cadence.

title: Aurora Backup Policy
text: Aurora, a legacy reporting storage system, performs incremental backups every twelve hours.

title: Developer Productivity Worker Platform
text: Developer Productivity maintains Cirrus for production asynchronous workloads.

title: Cirrus Retry Policy
text: Production Cirrus retries failed jobs at most five times before dead-letter handling.

title: Cirrus Production Retry Policy — Pending Revision
text: Production Cirrus failed jobs use a retry limit of three attempts under the pending retry-policy revision. The revision has not yet taken effect.

title: Payroll Operations
text: Payroll Operations manages monthly salary processing and tax statements.

title: Nimbus Session Cache
text: Nimbus Session Cache stores authenticated session metadata for ten minutes.

title: Nimbus Analytics Cache
text: Nimbus Analytics Cache stores dashboard aggregates for thirty minutes.

title: Helios Ownership
text: Helios is operated by the Identity Foundations team.

title: Identity Foundations Production Cache
text: Identity Foundations maintains Solstice for production session metadata caching.

title: Solstice Production Cache Policy
text: Production Solstice caches validated session metadata for ten minutes.

title: Solstice Production Cache Policy — Previous Revision
text: Production Solstice caches validated session metadata for twenty minutes. This was the previous policy before the current ten-minute duration.

title: Security Platform Signing Service
text: Security Platform maintains Meridian for production API credential signing.

title: Meridian Production Key Rotation
text: Production Meridian signing keys rotate every twelve hours.

title: Meridian Key Rotation — Pending Revision
text: A pending Meridian production policy sets signing-key rotation to every six hours. The revision has not yet taken effect.

title: Cumulus Worker Retry Policy
text: Cumulus worker jobs retry failed asynchronous tasks seven times before quarantine handling.

title: Cafeteria Menu Operations
text: Cafeteria Menu Operations publishes weekday lunch menus and ingredient notices.

title: Orion Log Retention
text: Orion Log Service retains diagnostic logs for seven days.

title: Orion Metrics Retention
text: Orion Metrics Service retains aggregated metrics for thirty days.
